pagerduty-bot: PAGED: infer-runtime (us-west1) — sudden spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts, error rate ~18% over last 5m. Pager triggered.

maria-sre: i'm on pager, joining now. pulling up traces and the deploy timeline.

ashok-eng-runtime: oncall here, saw a backlog in the runner queue + recurring segfaults in model_runner process on a subset of hosts.

maria-sre: can you paste the tail of the runner logs? i see repeated `SIGSEGV` and `malloc` errors in the same binary region.

ashok-eng-runtime: here's a clipped excerpt from one host: ```
[2026-03-17T06:21:12Z] model_runner[1342]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f1a2bcd1234 sp 00007ffc3a2f3e80 error 4 in model_runner+0x1a2b[7f1a2abcd000+0x30000]
[2026-03-17T06:21:12Z] model_runner[1342]: double free or corruption (!prev)
[2026-03-17T06:21:12Z] kernel: Killed process 1342 (model_runner) total-vm:1024000kB, anon-rss:812000kB
```

eva-mlops: correlating with traffic — most 5xx come from long-sequence chat requests hitting a canary quant-kernel rollout (v3-quant).

ben-support: we're seeing customer reports for slow/502 in several hosted routes, customers in us-west only so far. no PII exposed. @maria-sre estimating impact ~15-20% error for affected routes.

maria-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) take canary model variant v3-quant out of routing, 2) scale-up older stable runner pool (v2 production) and route traffic there, 3) enable fast-fail for long sequences to reduce memory pressure.

kirin-oncall: starting traffic reweight now — shifting 80% of traffic off v3-quant to v2-prod in us-west. watching RT and error rate.

ops-bot: action: reroute completed. traffic_reweight job id=reroute-3412348765-1 status=ok.

maria-sre: ops, please also cordon the hosts with repeated segfaults and collect coredumps. set DEBUG=1 for those nodes and attach core tar to the incident ticket.

ashok-eng-runtime: cordon + core collection started. one host shows kv-cache growth above historic baseline before the crash — suspicious. dumping kvcache metrics.```
kv_cache_size_bytes: 1.9GB -> 3.7GB (spike)
kvcache-evictions: 0 -> 0
```

eva-mlops: that matches a regression in the quantified attention kernel that was part of v3-quant: it disables a defensive kvcache trimming heuristic to speed throughput. likely memory blowup on long sequences.

maria-sre: for safety revert the kernel flag for v3-quant and keep it out of routing. we should also add an autosupervisor rule to evict stale kvcache on growth > 2GB per worker.

ashok-eng-runtime: created rollback PR to restore kvcache-trim and disable v3-quant flag: https://git.redwood/infra/rollbacks/PR-4523 (deploying hotfix to canary hosts).

kirin-oncall: error rate dropping — now at ~3% and falling. timeouts much lower. customer pings reduced.

ben-support: notifying impacted customers with ETA for full recovery and root-cause follow-up.

maria-sre: next steps after stabilization: 1) full postmortem, 2) add automated test for long-sequence kvcache growth in CI, 3) add alerting threshold for sudden kvcache doubling per host, 4) validate quant-kernel memory regression offline.

eva-mlops: capturing a repro with synthetic long-context prompts. will run under valgrind/ASan on dedicated hardware.

ashok-eng-runtime: follow-up playbook actions logged: incident ticket #INC-2026-3412348765, cores uploaded to s3://redwood-cores/INC-3412348765/, rollback deployed to canary, evict rule PR opened.

maria-sre: handing off to kirin for watch and postmortem drafting. i'm un-paging. thanks everyone for the fast moves. :thumbsup:

kirin-oncall: taking handoff — will monitor for 2 hours and start the postmortem draft. adding owners: @ashok-eng-runtime, @eva-mlops, @ben-support.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVED: pager cleared by maria-sre at 2026-03-17T06:43:22Z (duration ~22m).

kirin-oncall: final notes — root cause: kvcache trim heuristic disabled in a perf-driven quant-kernel change causing unbounded memory growth on long sequences -> kernel crash/segfault -> elevated 5xx. mitigation: rollback + reweight to stable model, evict rule + alert. postmortem timeline and customer impact sent to ops channel.

ben-support: customers patched with status update. no escalations.

maria-sre: closing thread here; will update postmortem draft link when ready.
